clause: Batch stack utilities: load-into-stack, statistics, contact-sheet family, watched-folder [STU-AUT-013]

scope.summary: Implement the deduped stack/utility batch capabilities on the one runner: load files into one document as layers with optional auto-align/stacking; stack statistics render (mean/median/max/min/range/std-dev/summation modes); utility batches (contact-sheet, multi-page presentation, fit-to-size, split-scanned-images, panorama-merge); watched-folder asset export (continuously export assets from layers whose names carry export directives on change).
expected_tests: live: load-files-into-stack builds one layered document
test: stack statistics median render correct
live: watched-folder export emits assets on layer-name directive change

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Stack, statistics & utility batches (model layer)

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
